card: CTX-F dispatch: factory readiness, and the gate that makes one bake true (P-124)
seat: planner-run session (Claude), hauska-factory-ctx-f, worktree P:/tmp/ctx-f-readiness, branch feat/ctx-f-bake-readiness. No sub-agents wrote code. Two background sub-agents (Neon project/branch recon; LDT transitive-import-closure diff) produced read-only findings, each adversarially checked against live source (a real read-only DB query; a real GitHub API check-run query) before this lane built on them.
nameCollisionNote: An unrelated lane also named 'ctx-f' closed 2026-08-28 against F-06/F-08 (zoning verdict / city-limits). Confirmed different mission at CP1; not inherited, not superseded.
missionPremise: P-124 reversed A-027's 'one bake; do not rebake' for this sprint. 'One bake' is only true a second time if the bake refuses to run against an incomplete dataset -- this lane builds that refusal, plus the staging/pin/tier2 conditions the dispatch named as prerequisites for a safe rebake. Mid-session, doc-repo-26 (independently cross-derived with CTX-G, verified live at source by this lane) established a load-bearing addition to item 1: a rail's own coverage verdict is meaningless if scored against an under-instantiated parcel_record population, which is true today for Williamson (46.9%) and Caldwell (51.4%) of the six CTX counties.

completionPredicate.item1_readinessGate: MET, INCLUDING THE MID-SESSION INSTANTIATION ADDITION. requirePreBakeReadiness (src/lib/publish-readiness-gate.mjs) runs two checks before any bake in runBastropPublish, either target, in this order: (a) instantiation -- parcel_record row count vs landing_cad_property distinct prop_id, floor 0.99, refuses COUNTY_UNDERINSTANTIATED naming cadN/parcelRecordN/ratio/shortfall; (b) per-rail -- parcel_gate_verdict for every rail in DEFAULT_SCHED_RAIL_KEYS, refuses RAIL_UNACCOUNTED (no row) or RAIL_REFUSED (verdict='refuse', names the unaccounted count). Both proven by violation: a Williamson-shaped fixture and a deliberately-refused-rail fixture each refuse through the FULL runBastropPublish path (not just a unit assertion), confirmed zero bake calls happen before the gate passes. `it must answer what executes/triggers/fails it, and name what bypasses it` -- answered in the module's own doc header (Executes/Triggers/Fails/Bypasses convention, matching this repo's existing publish-guards.mjs style).
completionPredicate.item2_stagingFix: MET for the parts within this lane's authority. factory-staging-reset's deployed template was missing all four *_NEON_PROJECT_ID/*_NEON_PARENT_BRANCH_ID vars entirely (confirmed at cloudbuild.publish.yaml:75 before the fix); added with live-rederived values (NEONDB and HAUSKA_MCP are the SAME Neon project cortex-prod/fancy-fire-06136146 and the same parent branch br-crimson-feather-aphfmy91, not two projects as the naming implies -- cross-confirmed by matching PRODUCTION_NEONDB_URL/PRODUCTION_HAUSKA_MCP_URL's shared host against the project's branch list and by finding the prior hand-run's 11-day-old stale staging branches still living under this exact project). Secret rotation now has a code path (src/lib/secret-rotation.mjs, wired into runStagingReset) using a newly-added @google-cloud/secret-manager dependency (no gcloud CLI exists in the runtime image to shell out to, confirmed by reading Dockerfile.publish). Pooler hosts refused via Neon's connection_uri?pooled=false plus the existing refusePoolerHost guard. NOT independently verified: a real `gcloud run jobs execute factory-staging-reset --wait` against the redeployed template, since redeploying is out of this lane's authorized scope (no production deploy). Static template correctness is confirmed; live execution is not.
completionPredicate.item3_siblingRecency: MET. MAX_SIBLING_AGE_HOURS=48 (documented rationale: clears bastrop-publish's own 6h Cloud Run timeout by a wide margin, catches the dispatch's own named example of a multi-day-old sibling), new STAGING_SIBLING_STALE code checked in evaluateStagingSibling right after the no-row check, SQL left unbounded so the true most-recent row is still found and its age named in the refusal (deliberately not folded into the WHERE clause, which would have collapsed 'no sibling ever' and 'sibling exists but stale' into one code, undoing this module's own one-code-per-reason design). Proven by violation: a live-shaped 9-day-old fixture and a boundary (bound+1h) fixture both refuse; a sibling one hour inside the bound passes through to the rest of the checks.
completionPredicate.item4_pin: MET, AS A HOLD WITH EVIDENCE, NOT A BUMP. Cloned legacy-design-tools at both the pinned SHA (65f924e8) and current main into disposable directories (never touched the shared P:/legacy-design-tools checkout), statically walked the transitive import closure of all four bundled bake CLIs at both SHAs. Result: NOT safe to bump -- all four closures grew (11-15 files each, 0 removed in any); two confirmed-reachable real behavior changes: loadLedgerBlockedFips's default facet set widening (changes which counties route to situs-recovery vs prop_id join) and buildableEnvelope/derive.ts's roadClassSetbackTableForJurisdiction fallback removal plus real Georgetown setback-table value changes. Separately corrected the dispatch's own framing: @empressaio/atom-contract@1.31.0 genuinely is published (doc-repo-26 confirmed: PR #27, published same-day), but LDT's own package.json/lockfile at both SHAs are still locked to 1.30.0 -- a consumption gap, not a publication absence. _LDT_SHA and _CONTRACT_VERSION held at current values. Findings reported to doc-repo-26, who accepted the hold outright.
completionPredicate.item5_tier2Exclusion: MET. tier2-conformant is excluded from runChunkedConformantBakes by default; opt-in only via flags.includeTier2ConformantStub (never a template default). Capability preserved (bundling entry, BAKE_CLI_FILES entry, the LDT-side file itself all untouched) -- retirement is an operator ruling, flagged to doc-repo-26, not decided here. tier2Summary reports {written:0, skipped:true, skipReason} rather than a bare zero when skipped, so a deliberate skip cannot be misread as a failed run. Proven with a dependency-injected bakeFn spy confirming zero tier2 invocations by default and a real invocation when the flag is set.
completionPredicate.item6_recordOnly: MET as record-only, per the dispatch's own framing ('two facts to record, not necessarily to fix'). Confirmed by direct code read: src/jobs/bastrop-publish.mjs never calls src/control/leases.mjs's takeScopedLease/lockLease/releaseLease anywhere, and no pg_advisory_lock usage exists in this repo -- nothing serializes concurrent bakes beyond operational discipline. recordBakePageEvent's body carries counts only (pageIndex, propIdsInPage, tier1Written, tier2Written, tier2Skipped, ms) -- no prop_id list -- and a refusal writes only runs.refuse_code, no parcel-level name at all. No code built for either; recorded here and in CP1/CP2.

scopeBasis: Repo hauska-factory only, this worktree only. Did not touch doc_repo except the WDLL and three checkpoint/close artifacts named by the dispatch -- doc_repo commits are not mine to make. Did not overlap CTX-G's county_facet_coverage/ledger rails, CTX-C's cadRoll rail definitions or the situs-collision join logic, or CTX-D's geometry/footprint absence definitions -- consumed only the already-landed parcel_gate_verdict contract. Two mid-session scope questions were resolved by doc-repo-26 rather than by this lane unilaterally: the cadRoll/dollar-fields-patch sequencing fix WAS ruled into this lane's repo territory but is explicitly blocked pending an external precondition (see leave_behind); the buildingFootprint gate-sched Cloud Build/Cloud Run wiring for CTX-G was routed here but explicitly ranked below this dispatch's own items and pre-authorized to defer. No production bake was run. No production deploy was made (the staging-reset template change is committed to source; it takes effect only on the next `gcloud builds submit --config=cloudbuild.publish.yaml`, which this lane did not run).
